releases.new: Draw a marginal heatmap strip in density_heatmap by setting marginal_x or marginal_y to heatmap, sharing the main plot's color scale.
releases.breaking: hex_to_rgb now raises an error for hex codes of invalid length and warns on codes with alpha; map traces now need newer browsers (Safari 15, Chrome 56, Firefox 51).

releases.new: Add quiver traces to draw vector fields as arrows, and a Share Chart modebar button that creates a chart-sharing link through Plotly Cloud.
releases.breaking: Removed the deprecated figure factory create_ functions, Orca and Kaleido below 1.0, the engine argument, and the mapbox traces; switch to the map equivalents and update color strings.

releases.new: Create quiver charts to visualize vector fields with arrows, and use a new Share Chart modebar button to generate a sharing link via Plotly Cloud.
releases.breaking: Removed deprecated Figure Factory create_* functions, old Kaleido and Orca image export, the engine argument, and all mapbox traces; switch to map traces, newer Kaleido, and check color formats.

releases.new: Set a font directly when creating subplots with make_subplots, and sort unified hover label items by value using the new hoversort layout attribute.
Draw maps with the new px functions scatter_map, line_map, choropleth_map and density_map, which render with maplibre instead of mapbox.
Add subtitles to plot titles through the new subtitle attribute on layout title, along with new tick label positioning options and shape vertex shifts.
Set bold weight, italic style, and small-caps variant on fonts in figures, via the updated Plotly.js 2.32.0 bundled with this release.
Control stacking order of cartesian traces with the new zorder attribute, and enable hover across multiple subplots sharing an axis, via the Plotly.js 2.31.1 update.
